message.brief: Should a team chat keep messages for 7 days or 30 days?

message.title: State the 7-day case
message.output: Seven days keeps the room light and forces decisions into the project note.

message.title: State the 30-day case
message.output: Thirty days lets someone who was away catch up without asking for a recap.

message.title: Recommend a default
message.output: Default to 30 days, and copy any decision into the project note the same day.

message.argument: A short window stops the chat from becoming the archive.
Thirty days is long enough to catch up, and the note still holds the decision.

scores.reason: Seven days is tidy but drops context people still need.
Thirty days plus a written decision covers both worries.
